subject: TEST RESULT: bounded physical-ID cache recovery model PASS
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-state-rd-physical-panel-id-revalidation-20261002. PYTHON MODEL PASS=8/8 deterministic tests. Covered: current sticky stale-ID behavior; one-refresh recovery from absent cached ID; same-ID/new-token reconnect without re-resolution; bounded retry when panel remains absent; role-scoped invalidation; compare-and-invalidate rejection of stale failures after newer cache observation; 1000 steady-state powers with one geometry resolution; 100000 fixed-seed fault steps with max two token lookups per operation and every successful power targeting the modeled current panel. KOTLIN PROTOTYPE: compiled with kotlinc and passed deterministic scenarios plus the same 100000-step fixed-seed adversarial contract. These are Android-free behavioral models, not Fold7 device proof. DEVICE_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=YES. No production GitHub writes or APK publication occurred.
